sections.kicker: Prepared for Makocraft by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Makocraft tells two stories at once, the no fluff workhorse and the lifestyle brand.
sections.keep: Your caption "NO FLUFF. JUST FISH." It is plain, it is yours and it fits a boat built for work.

pins.what: The bio claims the word every aluminium boat maker claims.
pins.why: Toughest needs a reason. Nothing in the bio says what makes a Makocraft tougher than the tinnie next door.
pins.how: Name the one build detail that earns the word.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Buyers hear a claim they have heard from every dealer.

pins.what: The pinned tile sells a playlist app, the caption below says no fluff.
pins.why: A buyer cannot tell if Makocraft is the simple workhorse or the lifestyle brand.
pins.how: Pick one as the lead and let the other support it.
pins.label: Your grid
pins.cost: The pinned post argues with your own tagline.

pins.area: Grid tile reads OUGH TIMES and IMPLE FIX with letters cut off
pins.what: Headline slides lose their first letters in the profile grid.
pins.why: Your bold condensed type is the most recognisable thing you have, and the grid crop breaks it.
pins.how: Keep headline text inside the centre of the frame.
pins.label: Your grid
pins.cost: The strongest visual asset reads as a mistake at first glance.

reference: Carhartt, from another category. It sells toughness by showing work, not by using the word.
